Title: Tournament Announcement: Columbia, SC, USA - July 11, 1998

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
I'll be running a tournament here in Columbia, SC
on Saturday, 11 July 1998 at the newly renovated
Heroes & Dragons (Boozer Center at the corner of
Bush River Rd and Broad River Rd near I-26).

Starting time is 10:00 am.

All DCI rules will be in effect. Prizes supplied by WotC.

--
During the Final round, all non-finalists are invited
to stick around and play a game with the "Methuselah
Myth" variant rules (including all of the optional
rules), so build a suitable deck for that too, if
you like.

Methuselah Myth rules:
http://www.wizards.com/VTES/VTES_Meth_Myth.html
